summary: Tested Phase 3 GHG fixes #10 (C7 monthly data model), #3 (Version History field-level tracking), #7 (EF+Formula info card), and #9 (dynamic input clearing). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering C7 create/update/yearly-summary/single-month/404 and version history field_changes. Frontend: smoke-tested login + Emissions page + Add Emission dialog + Scope 3 navigation. UI loads cleanly; the Add Emission dialog opens and renders steps correctly. No pre-existing C7 records were available in the test org, so deeper end-to-end UI verification of the EF+Formula card and history dialog rendering was limited to code review.

minor.issue: Yearly summary returns `entries: new_entries` only (v2 model); old (v1) entries are intentionally excluded but `has_old_model_data` flag is exposed. UI must surface this so users know there is unmigrated v1 data. Not a defect, but a UX consideration.

When updating an existing entry, `compute_field_changes` is invoked only with the keys {employees, monthly_total, activity_type, calculation_method, notes}. Other persisted fields (responsible_person*, scope3_activity, scope3_ef_id, etc.) will never appear in field_changes even when modified. Consider expanding the tracked fields list to mirror what the update_dict actually writes.

issues: React hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <select>'. Likely caused by a Radix Select being rendered with native <select> elements or icon spans inside option labels. Not user-blocking but should be cleaned up to avoid hydration mismatches and silence console errors in production.

action_items: (Optional) Expand fields tracked in compute_field_changes for C7 update path to include responsible_person*, scope3_activity, scope3_ef_id so the version history UI shows them on edit.
(Optional) Fix React hydration warnings about <span> nested in <option>/<select> on the Add Emission dialog.

Main agent should self-test the C7 EF+Formula info card and Version History dialog UI rendering by creating a real C7 entry through the wizard against an existing facility (no records exist in goyalsomil@hotmail.com org for current reporting year).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now 8332 lines, well above the 700-line guideline. C7 endpoints, models, and migration logic at lines 7863-8290 should be moved into a dedicated router module (e.g. /app/backend/routers/c7_employee_commuting.py) for maintainability.

The C7 update path in server.py (line 7960-7967) only computes field_changes for a hardcoded subset of fields. If a user only edits responsible_person or scope3_activity, the update will be persisted but produce zero field_changes and therefore an empty history entry will NOT be saved (the `if field_changes:` guard at line 7991). This silently loses audit trail for those edits.
Emissions.js at 5809 lines exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting EmissionEntryDialog, VersionHistoryDialog, and EditDialog into separate component files.
Frontend duplicates the field-label map (Emissions.js lines 5628-5663 and again in legacy fallback fieldsToCompare lines 5705-5720). DRY this into a single source of truth.

The C7 monthly endpoint at server.py line 7906 uses `category: {$regex: 'C7'}` for matching; this is greedy and would also match a hypothetical 'C17' or 'C70' category. Use exact string match (`category: 'C7 - Employee Commuting'`) or anchor the regex.

C7 yearly summary endpoint (line 8053) loads entries with `to_list(100)` — implicit 100-doc cap. For a year with 12 months that's fine, but if a facility ever has many migrated rows it will silently truncate. Use a higher cap or remove the limit since data is bounded by definition.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-test only — login + page load + Add Emission dialog open verified; full E2E of EF+Formula card and Version History dialog could not be exercised because the test org has no pre-seeded C7 records for the current reporting year.

One emission_history record per update is also written and intentionally retained for the GET /history assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_c7_monthly_and_history.py covers POST /api/emissions/c7/month (create + update with field_changes), GET /api/emissions/c7/{facility}/{year}, GET /api/emissions/c7/{facility}/{year}/{month} (incl. 404), and GET /api/emissions/{record_id}/history asserting field_changes array, changes_summary, changed_by_email population. Tests use unique reporting_year=2098 to avoid clashing with real data. Frontend E2E for EF+Formula card and Version History dialog still pending — they need a real C7 entry created via the UI wizard first; the test org has none. Two React hydration warnings on Add Emission dialog observed but non-blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects to root-cause. All Phase 3 backend fixes are working as intended. Two minor code-quality observations: (a) C7 update field_changes track only 5 fields, missing responsible_person + scope3_activity edits; (b) `category: {$regex: 'C7'}` is loose and could match category names like 'C17' if ever introduced.
